title.narrative: UNICEF co-led the Education Sector with MOE, coordinating the resources, commitments and interventions of 93 sector partners in line with the 2021 Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP). This was done by conducting 12 national and 34 sub-national coordination meetings; providing clear focus and ensuring a transparent fund allocation process to 12 partners through 3 emergency funding opportunities under the Syria Humanitarian Fund (SHF); and developing strategies and guidelines in response to identified gaps to ensure a holistic and coordinated response by partners. Examples of the latter include the Safe School Framework and Guidelines on Cash Voucher Assistance (CVA) in Education.
